title: AA-P10 live retest LR-02 (synthetic sketch written for this retest; not a real study, not a library case, no gold label)
prompt: Drinking green tea daily prevents memory decline in adults aged 65 and older.
context: A one-time survey of 2,000 adults aged 65 and older asked about tea habits and gave each person a single memory test. People who reported drinking green tea daily scored slightly higher on that test than people who rarely drank it; daily tea drinkers were also more physically active and more often had completed higher education, and the comparison was not adjusted for these differences.
